news.title: Fresh Character Posters for Ramayana Highlight Divine Trio and Regal Ravana
news.summary: The creators of the epic adaptation Ramayana have revealed striking new promotional visuals. One poster showcases the divine trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita during their exile, while another presents Yash in a powerful and majestic avatar as Ravana.

news.title: Fresh Character Stills Unveiled for Upcoming Epic Ramayana
news.summary: Makers of the anticipated movie Ramayana have rolled out new promotional imagery capturing distinct moods from the epic. Fans received a serene look at the primary trio during their forest exile alongside an imposing, gold-adorned glimpse of Yash portraying Ravana.

news.title: Tabu Set to Feature in a Special Character Teaser for Nagarjuna's Milestone Film King100
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's landmark project King100 is gearing up to release a dedicated promotional video introducing Tabu's character. This project marks a major onscreen reunion for the lead pair, who previously delivered the classic hit Ninne Pelladutha.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda's Historical Drama 'Ranabaali' Announces Promotional Docu-Series
news.summary: The makers of the upcoming historical film 'Ranabaali', starring Vijay Deverakonda and directed by Rahul Sankrityan, are launching a four-part documentary series titled 'Ranabaali: Never Forget'. The promotional venture highlights two years of research into Rayalaseema's forgotten history during British suppression. The film is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on October 16, 2026.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Applauds Nani and Srikanth Odela's 'The Paradise'
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR caught a screening of Nani's latest movie 'The Paradise' at Hyderabad's Sudarshan Theatre alongside various public representatives. He lauded the director, hero, and cast for creating a powerful visual narrative that highlights Telangana's culture, language, and the struggles of oppressed communities. Furthermore, he praised how the film realistically captures collective resistance against injustice.

news.title: Industry Buzz Points to Stronger OTT Valuations for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: According to trade reports, streaming platforms are currently offering higher prices for female-led projects featuring Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Industry insiders attribute this difference to Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian blockbusters and her vast social media following. Meanwhile, a prominent OTT platform has already locked a deal for the upcoming MS Subbulakshmi biopic starring Rashmika.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Steady Ticket Sales Despite Mixed Reception
news.summary: The Nani-starrer action drama The Paradise has crossed a massive Rs. 115 crore gross within its first two days in theaters. Despite polarized and mostly negative initial reactions, the film kept its momentum intact by selling 252K tickets on BookMyShow during its third day. The core team recently interacted with the media in Hyderabad to discuss their experiences.

news.title: Shocking Exit: Wildcard Contestant Mithilesh Walks Out of Bigg Boss Telugu 10 With Cash
news.summary: In an unprecedented twist on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, newly entered wildcard contestant Mithilesh accepted a cash temptation of 15 lakh rupees and left the house. Having just entered a day prior, he defended his choice by stating that he could not see a path to winning given the current house dynamics. This marks a first-of-its-kind voluntary exit in the reality show's history.

news.title: Nani Expresses Joy Over The Paradise Turning Negative Talk Into Positive Success
news.summary: During a press meet in Hyderabad, lead actor Nani opened up about the remarkable turnaround of his latest release, The Paradise. He praised the cast, crew, and technicians, specifically highlighting the dedication of the assistant directors and music director Anirudh. Describing the movie as a long-distance runner, Nani expressed gratitude to the audience for completely owning the project.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise the Deadliest of His 50-Year Career
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu showered praise on director Srikanth Odela and lead actor Nani during a recent media interaction for The Paradise. Revealing that he took the most retakes of his career for this film, Mohan Babu stated that he has not played such a menacing character in his five-decade journey. He also lauded producer Sudhakar Cherukuri for backing the project without compromising on the budget.

news.title: Nani Highlights Unusual Audience Trend for The Paradise
news.summary: During a media interaction, actor Nani discussed a rare phenomenon where audience reception for The Paradise improved progressively with every screening rather than starting strong and fading. Directed by Srikanth Odela and backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the project features a cast that includes Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, Sonali Kulkarni, and Kayadu Lohar.

news.title: Fresh Visuals Released for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: Brand-new promotional posters have been unveiled for the mythological epic Ramayana, highlighting the divine appearance of lead cast members Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey alongside Yash as Ravana. Helmed by director Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, the grand cinematic spectacle is slated for an IMAX global release in Diwali 2026.

news.title: Pen Studios Secures Domestic Distribution for Love And War
news.summary: Following a massive deal for Shah Rukh Khan's King, Pen Studios has acquired the all-India theatrical rights for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial Love And War through a commission-based arrangement. Headlined by Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal, the film is scheduled to hit the big screen during Republic Day week on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Popular Creator MrBeast Makes Surprise Appearance at Mumbai Promotional Event
news.summary: Global content creator MrBeast drew massive attention at a high-profile promotional gathering in Mumbai for the upcoming epic Ramayana after chanting Jai Shri Ram following an explanation from star Ranbir Kapoor. The Nitesh Tiwari directorial, scheduled for a Diwali 2026 release, generated considerable online traction due to the international YouTuber's unexpected red carpet appearance.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address On-Set Clashes Regarding The Paradise
news.summary: Following mixed responses to their recent film The Paradise, actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela opened up about their creative differences and arguments during production. Despite the tension on set, both confirmed that they share a deep family-like bond and mutual respect that goes beyond professional conflicts. The actor and director emphasized that their strong rapport remains unaffected by the film's theatrical outcome.

news.title: Mani Ratnam Applauds Karthik Subbaraj and LGBTQ-Themed Movie Dorothy
news.summary: Veteran filmmaker Mani Ratnam has lauded director Karthik Subbaraj and his recent controversial movie Dorothy, starring Keerthy Suresh. The acclaimed director praised the film's bold storytelling, sensitive handling of LGBTQ themes, and progressive narrative style. While drawing critical acclaim and industry appreciation, the movie is yet to receive a Telugu dubbed release.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Fans Await Clarity on Dual Sankranthi 2027 Releases
news.summary: While the makers of the Bobby-directed film Kaaka officially scheduled a Sankranthi 2027 release, uncertainty looms over Chiranjeevi's other project, Vishwambhara. Earlier reports had hinted at a festive release for Vishwambhara as well, leaving fans confused about the possibility of two films arriving in the same week. Audiences are currently waiting for official updates from the makers to clear up the confusion regarding the festival lineup.

news.title: Mohan Babu Addresses Rumors Surrounding The Paradise
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu has indirectly dismissed rumors regarding alleged tensions and disagreements on the set of The Paradise. He noted that intense creative discussions can happen during large-scale productions, but emphasized that outsiders rarely have the full picture.

news.title: Anirudh's Work on The Paradise Receives Mixed Reactions
news.summary: Composer Anirudh Ravichander, typically known for his reliable soundtracks, has faced criticism for his work on Nani's latest film, The Paradise. While his promotional singles were well received, critics felt the overall musical delivery in the feature fell short compared to his previous projects.

news.title: Nani and Mohan Babu Celebrate The Paradise Success
news.summary: Lead actor Nani described the audience reception to The Paradise as an overwhelming storm following its theatrical release. Veteran actor Mohan Babu also praised the film's director Srikanth Odela and producer Sudhakar Cherukuri while reflecting on his unique role as Sikandar Malik.

news.title: Vikram Prabhu's City Of Gold Unveils Intrigued First Look
news.summary: The makers of City Of Gold have released a promotional glimpse and first look featuring Vikram Prabhu and Shivathmika Rajashekar. Directed by debutant Siddharth, the project features a gritty premise set against the backdrop of the gold trade with music by Yuvan Shankar Raja.

news.title: Akkineni Nagarjuna Secures Second Place Among India's Wealthiest Actors
news.summary: According to the Hurun India Rich List 2026, Akkineni Nagarjuna stands as the second richest actor in the country with an estimated net worth of Rs 5,000 crore, making him the highest-ranking star from Tollywood. His massive fortune stems from a combination of family legacy assets, Annapurna Studios, extensive real estate investments around Hyderabad, and other business ventures. Four prominent Telugu actors successfully secured positions within the top ten of this national wealth compilation.

news.title: Tollywood Stars Line Up Multiple Film Releases
news.summary: Several popular Tollywood actors are preparing to showcase their work through multiple upcoming theatrical projects in the near future. Sharwanand, Vishwak Sen, Nithiin, and Malayalam star Dulquer Salmaan all have distinct lineups scheduled to hit the silver screen over the coming months. Fans can expect a flurry of diverse cinematic outings from these leading men as their respective production teams finalize release windows.

news.title: Producers Detail The Production Hurdles Behind Don't Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Makers SS Karthikeya and Shobu Yarlagadda recently discussed the distinct obstacles encountered while filming Don't Trouble The Trouble starring Fahadh Faasil. Despite its smaller scale compared to epics like Baahubali and RRR, the movie required shooting across approximately 79 different locations. The producers emphasized that rigorous pre-production planning and a universal emotional core helped the team navigate these logistically demanding setups smoothly.
